License supplement for objc2-core-foundation 0.3.2 and objc2-io-kit 0.3.2

These registry crates declare Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT, but their archives omit
the referenced repository-level LICENSE.md. For distribution with Citta, the
Apache-2.0 alternative is selected for these two exact crate versions.

UPSTREAM-LICENSE.md is the unmodified repository license explanation at:
https://github.com/madsmtm/objc2/blob/7b1abfd750a2cacaea71d6a56ecfb83cb7de560b/LICENSE.md

The source commit is recorded in both published crates' .cargo_vcs_info.json.
The workspace Cargo.toml at this commit declares version 0.3.2 and the three
license alternatives for framework crates. The two crates inherit that license.
The workspace author is Mads Marquart. No separate NOTICE file or copyright
notice was found in these two registry crate archives. The full upstream
explanation, including its Apple SDK discussion, is retained unchanged.

LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt is the unmodified canonical Apache 2.0 license from:
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt

Do not apply this supplement to other packages or versions without rechecking
their license declarations and upstream provenance. Citta's own noncommercial
license does not replace these third-party terms.
